issue.note: R002: E003 requires a=t_n>=0, but its statement and source contract do not define t_n, quantify its index or establish any admissible nonnegative grid base for each positive tau. None of the supplied definitions provides this information. R002/S003 consequently cannot specialize E003 at t_0=0 for either endpoint estimate or the rough-input extension. The multiplier conjugation identity transfers a bound from an already admissible source base; it proves neither existence of such a base nor t_0=0. Completing the supplied proof route requires a source-grounded completion of E003 and its grid definitions establishing an admissible base for each tau (in particular t_0=0 for the present proof). That changes a shared definition or public input and cannot be introduced as an R-local premise. The repaired loss choice, product estimate and scalar exponent calculations do not discharge this distinct grid condition.

resolution.note: Completed the shared E003 statement, binders and full source contract with the actual uniform grid t_jsrc=jsrc*tau, its step indices 0<=nsrc<Lsrc, and explicitly admissible first step for every positive tau. Primary readback of the identical cited FoCM-3.pdf checks p.4 and p.20 grid definitions, equations (7.2)-(7.3), and Lemma 7.2 with its pp.33-34 proof. R002/S003 and A003-A005 now choose step count 1 and index 0 before using the two endpoint estimates. The multiplier-conjugation identity is retained solely to transfer the bound from that established source base to arbitrary a. This repairs the public source contract rather than adding an R-local premise; target, H and supplied stage definition are unchanged.
